info.title: Assurance Studio API
info.description:
AI-powered threat modeling and risk assessment platform for medical devices, automotive ECUs, and IoT products.

This API provides endpoints for:

- Project management and configuration
- Architecture modeling (zones, components, data flows)
- Threat analysis and risk assessment
- Security requirements and mitigations
- Compliance verification and reporting
- Document upload and processing

**Authentication**:

- All endpoints require authentication via `X-API-Key` header or Supabase session cookie.
- API tokens are exchanged into short-lived JWT context per request (RLS enforced).
- Use the **Authorize** button to enter your API key for interactive testing.

**Rate Limits**:

- Read operations: 100 requests per minute
- Write operations: 30 requests per minute
- Report generation: 10 requests per minute
- Analysis jobs: 5 concurrent runs
